```plato

// A configurable six-degree-of-freedom joint: each translational axis of the
// joint frames carries a linear limit (meters) and each rotational axis an
// angular limit. FrameA and FrameB are the joint frames in each body's local
// frame.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Degrees_of_freedom_(mechanics))
type GenericJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    FrameA: Pose3D;
    FrameB: Pose3D;
    LinearX: LinearLimit;
    LinearY: LinearLimit;
    LinearZ: LinearLimit;
    AngularX: AngularLimit;
    AngularY: AngularLimit;
    AngularZ: AngularLimit;
}
```
